execution_model.Hermes Agent: Primary always-on reasoning and task-execution runtime. Learns repeatable workflows and executes approved tools/tasks.
execution_model.OpenClaw: Optional communications and multi-channel interaction layer for WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and browser-facing workflows when useful.
execution_model.GOX Control Plane: Owns task priority, revenue scoring, agent routing, QA, blocker handling, audit, and human-gate escalation.
execution_model.GOX Worker: Executes deterministic VPS-side jobs and records heartbeat, done, failure, and audit evidence.

human_only_gates: login approval or 2FA that requires the account owner
payment or withdrawal confirmation requiring the owner
platform tasks that explicitly require the registered human to perform them
operating_rule: Automate everything legitimately executable. Route unavoidable human gates as one-step handoffs and continue all unblocked lanes in parallel.
